comments.body: The enforcement point matters. A body without inspection powers is a newsletter with a flag.
Who decides which systems are frontier systems? That boundary will move faster than any treaty text.
Global oversight sounds fair until countries with opposite values have to agree on what human control means.
We already coordinate on aviation and nuclear risk. High-consequence software should not be uniquely exempt.
Exactly. The mandate needs audits and incident reporting, not just annual meetings.
That analogy breaks down: models diffuse globally and are much easier to reproduce than reactors.
Could a narrow first step cover only cross-border incident reporting? That seems more achievable.
A sunset clause would help. Renew the powers only if the body can show measurable risk reduction.
